title: Introduce your week
content: Record a two-minute update about what you want to improve this week.

title: Podcast gist
content: Listen to a short English podcast episode and write a three-sentence summary.

title: Tell me about yourself
content: Practice a concise self-introduction answer for interview settings.

title: Array warm-up
content: Solve one easy array problem and note the time and space complexity.

title: Opinion drill
content: Speak for two minutes on whether remote work helps learning.

title: Shadow a speaker
content: Replay a one-minute clip and shadow the speaker to copy rhythm and stress.

title: Strength story
content: Draft and practice an interview answer about your biggest strength.

title: String challenge
content: Complete one string manipulation problem and summarize your approach.

title: Daily recap
content: Explain your day out loud without reading from notes.

title: Lecture notes
content: Watch a technical talk for ten minutes and capture five key points.

title: Challenge story
content: Practice a STAR-format answer about a difficult project challenge.

title: Hash map practice
content: Solve a hash map problem and explain why the chosen data structure fits.

title: Teach a concept
content: Explain a concept you learned this month as if teaching a beginner.

title: News listening
content: Listen to an English news clip and identify the main claim plus two details.

title: Failure reflection
content: Practice an interview answer about a failure and what you changed after it.

title: Two-pointer drill
content: Finish one two-pointer problem and write down the invariant you tracked.

title: Persuasion prompt
content: Give a one-minute argument for a tool or habit that improved your learning.

title: Accent decoding
content: Listen to a speaker with an unfamiliar accent and note three phrases you caught.

title: Conflict example
content: Prepare a STAR answer about resolving disagreement with a teammate.

title: Stack basics
content: Solve a stack-based problem and note what triggers each push and pop.

title: Explain a chart
content: Describe a graph or dashboard aloud using clear comparison language.

title: Interview listening
content: Listen to a mock interview answer and list what made it effective.

title: Why this role
content: Practice a tailored answer for why you want a specific job or internship.

title: Binary search
content: Implement binary search from scratch and explain the boundary conditions.

title: One-minute pitch
content: Give a short pitch about a project you are proud of.

title: Long-form summary
content: Listen to a fifteen-minute talk and write a concise summary in your own words.

title: Leadership example
content: Practice an interview story that shows ownership or leadership.

title: Tree traversal
content: Solve a basic tree traversal problem and compare iterative and recursive options.

title: Progress reflection
content: Record how your confidence has changed since day one.

title: Capstone review
content: Choose one completed task and explain what you would improve if you repeated it.
